description: This file defines the 'Image_Canvas' class, which provides an abstract base class for handling different image output formats within an image creation library. It includes configuration, properties, and method stubs for drawing shapes, text, and images on a canvas, as well as factory method for creating format-specific subclasses.

classes.name: Image_Canvas
classes.description: Defines an abstract base for image drawing canvases supporting multiple output formats like PNG, JPEG, PDF, and SVG.

methods.name: Image_Canvas
methods.description: Constructor that initializes canvas properties such as position, size, and default font based on parameters.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the width of the canvas.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the height of the canvas.

methods.name: setLineThickness
methods.description: Sets the thickness of lines to be drawn.

methods.name: setLineColor
methods.description: Sets the color style for lines.

methods.name: setFill
methods.description: Sets the fill style, can be color, image, or gradient.

methods.name: setFillColor
methods.description: Sets the fill color for shapes.

methods.name: setFillImage
methods.description: Sets an image fill pattern (method stub).

methods.name: setGradientFill
methods.description: Sets a gradient fill style.

methods.name: setFont
methods.description: Configures font options for subsequent text drawing.

methods.name: setDefaultFont
methods.description: Resets font options to default.

methods.name: _reset
methods.description: Internal method to reset drawing styles and polygon data.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Public method to reset the drawing state.

methods.name: drawEnd
methods.description: Method stub for drawing line ends.

methods.name: line
methods.description: Draws a line between two points with optional line end styles.

methods.name: addVertex
methods.description: Adds a vertex to a polygon.

methods.name: addSpline
methods.description: Adds a spline vertex to a polygon.

methods.name: polygon
methods.description: Draws a polygon (method stub).

methods.name: rectangle
methods.description: Draws a rectangle (method stub).

methods.name: ellipse
methods.description: Draws an ellipse (method stub).

methods.name: pieslice
methods.description: Draws a pie slice (method stub).

methods.name: textWidth
methods.description: Calculates width of text (method stub).

methods.name: textHeight
methods.description: Calculates height of text (method stub).

methods.name: addText
methods.description: Writes text onto the canvas (method stub).

methods.name: image
methods.description: Overlays an image onto the canvas (method stub).

methods.name: setClipping
methods.description: Defines a clipping region (method stub).

methods.name: startGroup
methods.description: Begins a new grouping for drawing commands.

methods.name: endGroup
methods.description: Ends the current drawing group.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Outputs the current canvas content, setting appropriate headers.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the canvas content to a specified file (method stub).

methods.name: toHtml
methods.description: Creates an HTML image tag for the canvas and saves the image.

methods.name: factory
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate format-specific subclasses of Image_Canvas based on requested format.
